decisions.reason: The anamnesis app was publicly launched as a new product line with its own page and sits close to the core software, so the heavy visible commitment and its fit with the digitalization strategy favor persistence.
The education institute builds on the firm's training resources and supports customer loyalty, and its weak results can still be attributed to temporary pandemic disruption of in-person courses.
The remote support tool is cheap to maintain, is embedded in the customer support workflow, and gained relevance during the shift to remote work.
The analytics dashboard has its own page and supports the announced direction toward efficiently managed, connected practices, so dropping it would contradict that publicly stated strategy.
The complete practice bundle packages the core offer, has its own page and reflects central commitments, so it is likely to persist.

The listing portal is distant from the core and was only mentioned, so little would need justifying if it were dropped, but low running costs and synergy with the dental community make keeping it slightly more likely.
